title: Implement MealPlan Parsing
description: Implement `MealPlanParser.parse(_:)` using existing CookbookCore parsing primitives where appropriate, covering optional YAML frontmatter, block headings, section headers, comments, and recipe-vs-ingredient item discrimination with reused quantity parsing semantics.
acceptance_criteria: `MealPlanParser.parse(_:)` returns an empty `MealPlan` for empty input.
Frontmatter key/value pairs populate existing `Metadata` without introducing a new metadata type.
Block headings, optional named sections, comment items, and `@` references are parsed per spec.
`@` lines containing `/` become recipe items and those without `/` become ingredient items.
Comments outside any block/section are tolerated and discarded.

handoff_summary.completed: Added `MealPlanParser.swift` and implemented a non-throwing parser that returns an empty `MealPlan` for empty input, maps YAML frontmatter into `Metadata`, parses `==...==` block headings and optional `name:` sections, discards comments outside any active section, preserves comment items inside sections, and classifies `@` entries with `/` as recipes and without `/` as ingredients. Quantity parsing is reused through the existing inline parser by routing item lines through `Parser.parseRawStep(_:)`.
handoff_summary.risks: Compile-only verification had to use `xcrun swiftc -typecheck` with writable cache paths because `swift build` was blocked by sandboxed SwiftPM manifest/cache access. No automated tests were run per guardrails, so behavioral validation remains for the tester agent.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: Low. The change is isolated to a new source file in CookbookCore and reads existing parsing primitives without modifying them.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Kept the implementation scoped to a new `MealPlanParser` file. Reused the existing inline parser for quantity semantics by appending an empty `{}` only when a meal-plan reference has no explicit quantity, which allows multi-word names and paths to follow the same quantity/body parsing behavior as recipe ingredients.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No test suite or test runner was executed, per developer-agent guardrails. Compile verification was performed with `env HOME=/private/tmp CLANG_MODULE_CACHE_PATH=/private/tmp/clang-module-cache xcrun swiftc -typecheck -module-name CookbookCore Packages/CookbookCore/Sources/CookbookCore/*.swift`.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: `swift build` could not be used in this sandbox because SwiftPM manifest execution attempted blocked sandbox/cache operations. Meal-plan serialisation was not part of this bead and was not implemented here.

conflict_risks: Low. The change is isolated to a new source file in CookbookCore and reads existing parsing primitives without modifying them.
